# Amsirar Trip

> Licensed Morocco tour operator specializing in private Sahara desert expeditions, High Atlas treks, and imperial city tours in English, French, German, and Spanish.

## Docs

- [All Morocco Tours](https://amsirartrip.com/tours): Catalog of handcrafted multi-day Sahara desert circuits, imperial city routes, and mountain treks.
- [Marrakech Day Excursions](https://amsirartrip.com/excursions): Private day trips to Agafay Desert, Essaouira, Ouzoud Waterfalls, Imlil & Toubkal, and Ourika Valley.
- [About Us](https://amsirartrip.com/about): Over 20 years of local Berber heritage, licensed mountain guides, and modern air-conditioned vehicle fleet.
- [Contact & Booking Inquiries](https://amsirartrip.com/contact): Direct WhatsApp and email booking consultation for custom private Morocco travel itineraries.

## Multi-Day Tours

- [3-Day Desert Tour from Marrakech to Merzouga](https://amsirartrip.com/tours/merzouga-desert-adventure-3-days): 3-day tour from Marrakech to Marrakech (From 280 EUR). Private Sahara desert adventure to Erg Chebbi dunes with Dades Valley, Todra Gorges, and sunset camel trekking.
- [6-Day Morocco Tour from Casablanca](https://amsirartrip.com/tours/coast-and-cities-explorer-6-days): 6-day tour from Casablanca to Marrakech (From 640 EUR). Explore Casablanca, the blue city of Chefchaouen, imperial Fes, Merzouga Sahara dunes, and Marrakech.
- [3-Day Desert Tour from Fes to Marrakech](https://amsirartrip.com/tours/caravan-and-kasbah-experience-3-days): 3-day tour from Fes to Marrakech (From 310 EUR). Direct point-to-point desert expedition via Middle Atlas cedar forests, Ziz Valley, Erg Chebbi bivouac, and Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou.
- [5-Day Imperial Cities Tour from Casablanca](https://amsirartrip.com/tours/imperial-cities-and-coastline-5-days): 5-day tour from Casablanca to Fes (From 520 EUR). Cultural exploration of Rabat, Chefchaouen, Volubilis Roman ruins, Meknes, and imperial Fes medina.
- [10-Day Grand Morocco Circuit](https://amsirartrip.com/tours/grand-moroccan-circuit-10-days): 10-day tour from Marrakech to Casablanca (From 1150 EUR). Comprehensive Moroccan journey covering Marrakech, Atlas passes, Erg Chebbi desert, Fes, Chefchaouen, Rabat, and Casablanca.
- [4-Day Desert Tour from Marrakech to Merzouga](https://amsirartrip.com/tours/atlas-and-desert-escape-4-days): 4-day tour from Marrakech to Marrakech (From 390 EUR). Extended Sahara desert itinerary with leisurely exploration of Dades Valley, Todra Gorges, and two nights in the desert region.
- [4-Day Desert Tour from Agadir to Marrakech](https://amsirartrip.com/tours/coastal-and-desert-odyssey-4-days): 4-day tour from Agadir to Marrakech (From 420 EUR). From the Atlantic coast through Taroudant and saffron capital Taliouine to Merzouga dunes and Marrakech.
- [Erg Chegaga Desert Tour from Marrakech](https://amsirartrip.com/tours/chegaga-wilderness-expedition-3-days): 3-day tour from Marrakech to Marrakech (From 340 EUR). Off-the-beaten-path Sahara expedition to the wild, towering dunes of Erg Chegaga via Zagora and M'Hamid El Ghizlane.
- [7-Day Northern Morocco Tour from Tangier](https://amsirartrip.com/tours/northern-heritage-trail-7-days): 7-day tour from Tangier to Marrakech (From 780 EUR). Northern heritage route crossing the Rif Mountains, Chefchaouen, Fes, Middle Atlas, and Marrakech.

## Marrakech Day Excursions

- [Agafay Desert Sunset Camel Ride & Dinner](https://amsirartrip.com/excursions/agafay-desert-sunset): Agafay Desert (From 45 EUR). Sunset camel trek across stony desert dunes followed by an authentic Berber dinner under canvas tents.
- [Essaouira Coastal Escape Day Trip](https://amsirartrip.com/excursions/essaouira-coastal-escape): Essaouira (From 35 EUR). Historic Portuguese ramparts, artisan wood workshops, active fishing harbor, and coastal breeze.
- [Imlil & Toubkal Atlas Adventure](https://amsirartrip.com/excursions/imlil-toubkal-adventure): High Atlas Mountains (From 40 EUR). Guided hike through Berber walnut groves and mountain trails with views of Mount Toubkal (4,167 m).
- [Ourika Valley & Setti Fatma Waterfalls](https://amsirartrip.com/excursions/ourika-valley-discovery): Ourika Valley (From 30 EUR). Mountain riverbanks, lush valley orchards, and guided hike to the 7 waterfalls of Setti Fatma.
- [Ouzoud Waterfalls Guided Day Trip](https://amsirartrip.com/excursions/ouzoud-waterfalls-day-trip): Ouzoud Waterfalls (From 35 EUR). Morocco's highest waterfalls (110 m), wild Barbary macaques, and scenic boat ride at the cascade basin.
- [Marrakech Hot Air Balloon Sunrise Flight](https://amsirartrip.com/excursions/sunrise-hot-air-balloon): Marrakech Palmeraie (From 190 EUR). Sunrise flight over desert plains and Atlas peaks with traditional Berber breakfast in a caidal tent.
